_how_to: One entry per role, shown on the Careers page in this order. slug is used in the page address (#slug). type is Full-time or Contract. status is the label shown beside the title (for example Hiring now, Opening in 2027, Open call). pay is optional: Don, Nov 25, 2026: leave pay off the postings for now and discuss it with candidates. If a figure is ever added it comes from Don; never invent one.

roles.title: Customer Success and Implementation Lead, AIOS Cloud
roles.summary: You bring new organizations onto AIOS Cloud and stay with them after launch. You are the person a client calls.
do: Run onboarding for each new client, from kickoff to the first governance review held in the platform.
Set up AIOS Cloud to match the client's organization: its strategy, initiatives, risks and owners.
Answer support questions, and bring what clients ask for back to the product team.
Work with our partners on client engagements in their markets.
bring: Experience onboarding or supporting enterprise software clients, in customer success, implementation or consulting.
Ease in front of senior leaders, and clear writing.
Working knowledge of AI governance or risk management, or a record of learning a new field quickly.

roles.title: Account Executive, United States
roles.summary: You sell AIOS Cloud and the knowledge bases to organizations in the United States.
do: Build and run your own pipeline of enterprise, small-business and government buyers.
Run demos and take each deal from the first conversation to signature.
Sell team plans of the CAIO Knowledge Base and the AI Knowledge Base alongside the platform.
Tell the product team what buyers ask for and where deals stall.
bring: A record of closing business software deals with executive buyers.
Experience selling governance, risk, compliance, security or data products is a plus.
The ability to work without a large sales operation behind you.

roles.title: Account Executive, Europe
roles.summary: You sell AIOS Cloud and the knowledge bases to organizations in Europe.
do: Build and run your own pipeline of enterprise, small-business and public-sector buyers in Europe.
Run demos and take each deal from the first conversation to signature.
Sell team plans of the CAIO Knowledge Base and the AI Knowledge Base alongside the platform.
Tell the product team what European buyers ask for and where deals stall.
bring: A record of closing business software deals with executive buyers in European markets.
Working knowledge of how the EU AI Act and GDPR shape what buyers need.
The ability to work without a large sales operation behind you.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, AIOS Cloud
roles.summary: You build and operate AIOS Cloud: the application, its data and its security.
do: Ship features across the platform, which is built on Python and PostgreSQL.
Own reliability and security: deployments, monitoring, incident response and access controls.
Direct and review the work of AI coding agents, which are part of how we build every day.
bring: Several years building and operating production web applications.
A security-minded approach to multi-tenant data, authentication and audit records.
Practice working with AI coding tools, and the judgment to check what they produce.

roles.title: Advisory Associates and Subject-Matter Reviewers
roles.summary: Two kinds of contract work: delivering advisory engagements with us, and reviewing knowledge base content in your field.
do: Advisory associates work on AI strategy and governance engagements alongside Alphaworx and its partners.
Reviewers check guides in the CAIO Knowledge Base and the AI Knowledge Base for accuracy in their area: regulation, security, risk or a specific industry.
bring: Senior practice in AI governance, risk, security, privacy or regulation.
For reviewers, depth in one jurisdiction or industry.
Clear writing, with claims you can source.
